mechanism: Both modafinil and caffeine are CNS stimulants that increase wakefulness and alertness through different mechanisms (modafinil via dopamine/norepinephrine, caffeine via adenosine antagonism), creating additive stimulant effects.
action: Monitor for excessive CNS stimulation symptoms (tremor, anxiety, insomnia, tachycardia); counsel patients to limit caffeine intake and avoid using both agents concurrently at high doses.
